scope: Existing visible guide data was retained unless a current primary/community source established a necessary correction. This report is for maintenance and is intentionally not rendered as per-card source clutter.

entries.version_or_context: Current wiki.gg curio data module; vanilla, Crimson Court and Color of Madness entries shown by this guide
entries.notes: The 90-card count was preserved. Courtyard entries were rechecked against the supplied Korean Courtyard table: Bloodflowers no longer lists an unsupported Blood interaction; Pile of Strange Bones now warns that Blood causes an ambush; Wine Crate adds Shovel → Firewood; and Thronging Hive correctly distinguishes its quest-only Oily Torch from an ordinary Torch. Quest-only cards remain explicitly labelled.
Courtyard is an Epic-length Bloodlight expedition; Farmstead uses wave fights without normal room corridors. Existing guide wording remains compatible.

entries.version_or_context: Fire's Edge Retail build 27987, 2026-09-14; installed koreana localization tables and hero string tables rechecked 2026-10-30
entries.notes: The planner now displays the current Korean strings for every included hero and recommended skill. This corrects legacy labels such as 성기사→성전사, 사냥개 조련사→조련사, 머스킷티어→총사, and the Runaway/Duelist skill labels. Runaway and Duelist retain their live rank rules; Duelist is explicitly marked as the exception that equips all seven combat skills, including the free 예상 stance switch. Recommendations distinguish normal expeditions from boss fights and retain the Retail 27987 balance baseline.

entries.item: Sunward Isles curio and region material
entries.version_or_context: Installed Workshop 1689234891 curio CSV, effect definitions, koreana.loc2 and original curio PNG assets checked 2026-10-30
entries.notes: The installed Workshop files remain the authority for current Korean titles, supply labels and effects. The earlier card art used full animation sprite sheets and therefore displayed incorrectly. On 2026-10-30 the 12 matching dungeon screenshots from the supplied Korean field-test record (post 125970) replaced those sheets; Ho-oh, Disheveled Tree and Esoteric Go Table use one isolated in-game frame each from the installed artwork. The same review corrects ‘하쿠타쿠의 영예’ and marks 검술의 달인 as a positive quirk rather than a disease.
The mod describes added curios, but a current public individual name/effect list was not established. Its overview card remains separate from the verified 90-card count.

entries.item: Courtyard Plus and Here Be Monsters: The New Shadow
entries.notes: Courtyard Plus change note already shown in the guide is retained. New Shadow author description confirms added enemies, but does not establish additional curio interactions for this table.
The referenced Workshop listing was removed from the community. No Raiju-specific curio effect is asserted in the guide.
